Right column: line 1 '- CUSTODIAL STAFF -' (Okerman supervisor, no school -> district-wide), then school sub-headings: line 5 'Lunenburg High School' (Bissonnette, Bond, Bourgeois, Massak, Sanderson -> high), line 25 'Turkey Hill Middle School' (Bellafiore, Paton, Sideleau), line 35 'Lunenburg Primary School' (Hirsch), line 41 'Passios Elementary School' (DelRossi, Kenney, Ricker); line 51 '- SCHOOL CROSSING GUARD -' (Powell, part-time at Elementary School driveway -> passios, no title printed so role_raw ''); line 57 '- FOOD SERVICE -' (Janice Johnson, Food Service Director, name on line 59 with her title on line 60; district-wide; SERVOMATION CORPORATION on line 58 is a company, ignored); line 63 '- CAFETERIA STAFF -' and line 64 'Lunenburg High School' (Beaulac, Catorio, Cioffi -> high). Lines 1, 25, 35, 41, 59, 64 hold a heading in one column and content in the other. Second Baker lines (4-9) are her other jobs (cafeteria aide, IMS math tutor) as bio detail, ignored. Lines with only dates, hours, replacement notes and page number (71) are ignored.
